risk: Echoing raw exception text could expose private diagnostics. Editable classifications could mislabel held payments or imply financial-release authority.
justification: Reviewed the five creReason response tokens against loadReconciliationEntries.safeReason, actual exception emitters and the generated contract. Only four known stored exception types are mapped; every other value becomes unrecognized. This output-only redaction vocabulary cannot mutate workflow, post money or release a hold. Contract parity, legacy-private-reason and closed-approval regressions cover this boundary; ADR 0125 records its limits.
